name: demo-precision
base_yaml:
version: '1'
hardware:
  joint_names:
  - demo_joint
  degrees_mode: false
guards:
- L1: motion
boundaries:
  joint_range:
    layer: L1
    type: single
    nodes:
    - callback: joint_position_limits
      params:
        lower:
        - -2.0
        upper:
        - 2.0
tasks:
  comparison_demo:
    boundaries:
    - joint_range
safety:
  control_hz: 30
  enforcement_mode: enforce
